messages:
sam: FYI we got an update from NexaSupply on RMA 9921 — they want to split the replacement GPUs into two shipments due to stock constraints. Asking for customs docs and requoted expedite cost.

emily (NexaSupply): Sorry for the churn — original allocation had 8x A100s but DOA rate pushed us under threshold. We can ship 4 next-day air (ETA 48h) and 4 on sea (ETA ~14 days). Need HS code + declared value to clear EU customs.

lina: That split is rough for eu-prod-cluster, we were counting on all 8 to come in one go for the node rebuild. Can you confirm serials for the 4 air units so we can update inventory?

emily (NexaSupply): Shipping manifest will include serials. Draft manifest attached here: TRACKING-NTF-9921 (link). Air units S/N: ASDF1234, ASDF1235, ASDF1236, ASDF1237. Sea units S/N: QWER5678, QWER5679, QWER5680, QWER5681.

max: @lina if we only get 4 air GPUs in 48h we can bring one node back online (4x per node) but cost of degraded capacity will hit latency SLAs. What's the expected impact on throughput?

lina: We'll lose ~40% peak throughput for EU until sea shipment arrives. Autoscaler will bounce some traffic to us-west but that raises cross-region egress. Might need canary routing adjustments.

sam: Emily — can you confirm whether NexaSupply covers expedited air cost for DOA replacement or do we absorb? Previous RMA terms suggested vendor covers DOA replacement shipping but not duties/taxes.

emily (NexaSupply): Standard RMA covers DOA replacement shipping (air) on vendor side. Duties and import taxes are customer responsibility. For split shipments, we'll cover the air leg. Sea leg shipping covered as well, but duty handling is on your side.

finance-ops: Quick note — if duties are >$500 per shipment we need PO update and likely a chargeback approval. Please submit the proforma invoice so we can pre-approve.

max: Also confirm HS code snippet for GPU import: 8471.49.00? Customs wants exact classification. If we declare wrong value they may hold.

emily (NexaSupply): HS code 8471.49.00 is what our shipping team uses for GPUs. Declared value we'll set to unit price on PO: USD 12,500 each. Proforma attached: PROFORMA-9921.pdf (link).

lina: Can we request NexaSupply to consolidate the sea leg to a single bill of lading and mark as "partial replacement" on docs so customs doesn't treat as new sale? That sped clearance previously.

emily (NexaSupply): We can mark sea BOL as "replacement parts — warranty" and include original PO & RMA case ID 9921. Will do.

sam: Great. Action items: 1) Emily to send formal proforma + finalized manifest and BOL notes. 2) Finance to pre-approve duties up to $2k per shipment or escalate. 3) Lina/Max to reroute critical traffic to us-west and put canary on latency-sensitive routes. 4) Ops to prep node rebuild plan for staggered arrival.

rma-bot: RMA 9921 status changed to PARTIAL_SHIPPED by emily (NexaSupply) at 1791234601 — Air (4 units) dispatched, SEA (4 units) pending. Tracking: https://shp.example/NTF-9921.

finance-ops: Received proforma, initiating pre-approval. If duties exceed estimate will DM procurement.

max: Lina — once air units land can you do a quick smoke test on reclaimed node and post results here? Keep it lightweight: cuda-smi check, stress 5m, training tail-latency smoke.

lina: Yep — I'll run smoke and post logs. ETA for air arrival 48h per emily.

sam: Thanks all. Emily, please ping when air hitting customs so we can coordinate on-site pick-up (we'll use our broker). :thumbsup:
